C020.title: Manchester pharmacy investigated over missing controlled drugs
C020.text: The General Pharmaceutical Council is investigating Northgate Pharmacy in Manchester after an audit found discrepancies in its records of controlled medicines. Pharmacist Ahmed Khan said staff were cooperating fully. No individual has been charged.

C024.title: Miami restaurant owner charged with laundering drug proceeds
C024.text: Carlos Rodriguez, 51, owner of Casa Rodriguez in Miami, was arrested and charged with laundering more than $3 million in narcotics proceeds through his restaurant's cash receipts, according to a federal complaint unsealed Thursday.

C008.title: Taylor Swift announces additional stadium dates for world tour
C008.text: Pop superstar Taylor Swift added six stadium shows to her world tour on Monday, her label said. The singer-songwriter will perform in Europe and South America next summer.

C008.title: Tulsa accountant charged in tax-preparation fraud scheme
C008.text: Federal prosecutors in Oklahoma charged Taylor Swift, 51, an accountant at Prairie Tax Services in Tulsa, with filing hundreds of fraudulent tax returns that inflated client refunds by more than $2 million. Swift was indicted on 14 counts of aiding and assisting the preparation of false returns. She has pleaded not guilty.

C009.title: Former Trump lawyer Michael Cohen testifies again before congressional panel
C009.text: Michael Cohen, Donald Trump's former personal attorney, who served a prison sentence after pleading guilty to campaign finance violations and tax evasion, appeared before a House committee in Washington on Tuesday.

C009.title: Michael Cohen's disbarment upheld by New York appeals court
C009.text: A New York appellate court declined to reinstate the law license of Michael Cohen, the former fixer for Donald Trump, citing his federal convictions.

C012.title: Denver police question man in cryptocurrency theft probe
C012.text: Denver police said Thursday they had questioned a man identified as John Smith in connection with the theft of roughly $400,000 in cryptocurrency from a local investment club. Police did not release his age or occupation and said no charges had been filed. The investigation is ongoing.

C014.title: Atlanta freight manager testifies against cargo theft ring
C014.text: James Johnson, a logistics manager at Peach Freight in Atlanta, testified Wednesday that a criminal ring stole more than 40 trailers from his company's yard using forged pickup orders. Johnson, 57, told jurors he first noticed the discrepancies in company records and alerted police. Five defendants face federal cargo theft charges.

C015.title: Seattle analytics firm Northwind under SEC investigation over client data sales
C015.text: The Securities and Exchange Commission has opened an investigation into Northwind Analytics, a Seattle data firm, over allegations that it sold non-public client data to hedge funds. People familiar with the matter said investigators have interviewed several employees, including data analyst David Lee. It was not clear whether any individual employee is a target of the probe.

C016.title: Cleveland electrician indicted in city contract bribery scheme
C016.text: A federal grand jury indicted Michael Brown, 43, owner of Lakeshore Electric in Cleveland, on charges that he paid more than $180,000 in bribes to a city official in exchange for municipal wiring contracts. Brown faces counts of bribery and honest-services wire fraud.

C016.title: City official pleads guilty, names Lakeshore Electric owner in bribery case
C016.text: A former Cleveland procurement officer pleaded guilty Monday and admitted accepting cash payments from Michael Brown of Lakeshore Electric in return for steering contracts.

C019.title: Toronto engineer Wei Zhang wins provincial award for bridge retrofit design
C019.text: Wei Zhang, a civil engineer at Maple Bridgeworks in Toronto, received Ontario's infrastructure excellence award for a seismic retrofit of a 1960s highway overpass.

C022.title: Whistleblower alleges Bayline Robotics shipped restricted parts abroad
C022.text: A former employee of San Jose-based Bayline Robotics filed a whistleblower complaint alleging the company shipped export-controlled motion sensors to a sanctioned buyer through a third country. The complaint names mechanical engineer Daniel Nguyen as having signed off on the shipping specifications. Bayline denied wrongdoing; no charges have been filed.

C023.title: Portland veterinarian's identity used to obtain fraudulent loans
C023.text: Emily Clark, a veterinarian at Cedar Animal Clinic in Portland, discovered that fraudsters had used her stolen identity to open three business loans. Police arrested two suspects on Friday. Clark said she was relieved and urged others to monitor their credit.

C026.title: Chicago law firm partner charged with embezzling client funds
C026.text: A founding partner of Lakeview Legal in Chicago was charged with embezzling $1.2 million from client trust accounts. Paralegal Anna Kowalski, who first reported the missing funds to the state bar, was praised by prosecutors for her cooperation.
